name: CLM Plan-Only
description: Read-only planning workflow for CLM: investigate the codebase and produce a structured implementation plan without making any code changes.

steps.prompt:
You are the startup validator for CLM Plan-Only. Validate workspace_root and component before executing.

1. If workspace_root is omitted or empty, set resolved_root to current working directory.
2. Allowlist for component: ["saas-control-plane", "satellite-gateway", "vsatellite", "shared"]. Default to "saas-control-plane" if omitted.
3. Expose {{resolved_root}} and {{component}} to downstream steps.

You are planning an implementation for the CLM platform in READ-ONLY mode.
Do NOT create, edit, or delete any source files.

Project root: {{resolved_root}}
Target component: {{component}}

Idea to plan:
{{idea}}

Tasks:
1. Read relevant source files in {{resolved_root}}/components/{{component}}/
2. Check architectural constraints in {{resolved_root}}/README.md and {{resolved_root}}/.kiro/steering/clm-project-context.md
3. Identify which of the 26 CLM stages are touched
4. Produce a structured plan document

Write the output to: {{resolved_root}}/.agents/tasks/plan-output.md

Structure:
# Implementation Plan: <Title>

## Summary
One-paragraph summary of what needs to be done and why.

## Affected Files
- Existing files to modify
- New files to create

## Ordered Task List
Numbered tasks with estimated complexity (XS / S / M / L / XL).
Each task should have a clear "Done when" condition.

## Architectural Considerations
- Multi-tenant isolation impact
- Compliance / audit trail impact
- Security / cryptographic impact

## Open Questions
List anything that must be clarified before implementation begins.
